overall_notes: The paper focuses on evaluating Small Language Models (SLMs) for news summarization. It uses reference-based automatic metrics (BERTScore, HHEM-2.1-Open, Summary Length) with LLM-generated references, but does NOT use LLMs as judges/scorers. The human evaluation was limited in scale (20 news instances, 6 annotators) and focused only on relevance. The extraction was generally good but contained many duplicate entries that needed consolidation.
